about: Review F2, round 4: a remote or container launcher anywhere in argv refuses the adapter, whatever comes after it. ["ssh", "host", "node", "read-job.mjs", "{id}"] is refused although node has a script right after it; a launcher without a placeholder is refused too. A local script is accepted.

refusedIncludes: operation job-remote: argv holds ssh, a remote or container launcher
operation job-remote: {id} reaches ssh, which passes its arguments on
operation health-container: argv holds docker, a remote or container launcher
